enchantments.tooltip: +10 Enhancement Bonus: +10 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Spearblock VII: Passive: Reduces physical damage taken by 14, except from Bludgeoning or Slashing weapons. (Damage Reduction: 14/Slash, Bludgeon)
Axeblock VII: Passive: Reduces physical damage taken by 14, except from Bludgeoning or Piercing weapons. (Damage Reduction: 14/Pierce, Bludgeon)
Hardened Exterior 2: You gain a +2 profane bonus to AC.

Orlassk's Prison: This shield radiates with the power of the Lord of Stone. A shield bash will turn the target to stone. This effect can trigger once ever 90 seconds. A successful Fortitude save (DC 65) negates this effect.
Stone Paws: In Animal Form, Gain +2[W] and DR 15/Adamantine.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
